content: Mbumbukiam-qa nømendim matev, atanakha-zapazapa-za-qa nømendim matev, gèløvuám
Khøuwa nøme, Felisi ezoqam neka Mozes-qa guguna manqat nømendim ezoqam ndozáv, Yesu-te. Zelusalem taon-té ginduzáv.
Yaq āv giniqeivím nqǽgo: Yesu-gi paev ezoqa nøme, lou gilog, ndigu zenda uni sunguziáv, av Felisi ezoqam, ezoqa gi꞉zømesimam.
(Nginik Felisi ezoqam neka Zu ezoqam ate gi꞉goam, lou logemáv, zenda uni sunguzumav tøgoat. Geté atanakha-zapazapa-za-qá matev mbopaevemɨ́n, taqa yaq-te.

Yaq ezoqam maket manqei-te gindu-qavazɨn, ndigu mø̀ndøkhæ-khakuamɨ́n, váev lou gilogɨn. Ndigu matev nøme kopoáv ndimbopaev, tigi atanakha-zapazapa-za-te gindu-upøgimam, kopømba ande av kap neka pot neka melek neka venanqei nonqo sunguzam matev.)

Yaq ndigu Felisi ezoqam neka Mozes-qa guguna manqat nømendim ezoqam, Yesu gimbo-bevøpem, “Gekha zapâ ndøgo, qogi paev ezoqam nigi atanakha-zapazapa-za-qa matev pøpøvumav ndøgo? Ndigu bugukhokhof zenda uni sunguzumáv, lou gilogɨn.”
Yaq Yesu gezø-qavøiu, “Mbumbukiam-ge manqa vevezam ezoqam Aezaya, unimanqatin manqat ndø-eín, zo khavozam ezoqam-qa yaq-te. Ndego āv gene-peawám nqǽgo,

content.text: ‘Mbumbukiam ge-ein: Nginik no tou mbá ginømbe-vizáp. Geté tiqa mbøni qámbá no-te.
Ndigu noqa iz, khokhó sege-eqawát. Zapa ndǿgo, ndigu ezoqam-qá nømendim matev mba me꞉zømesimít. Ambá noqā nømendim matev.’

content: Mbumbukiam-qa nømendim matev, zo mòzo-ivøvém. Geté ezoqam-qá nømendim matev zombopavét.”
Yaq Yesu gezø-ein, “Mbumbukiam-qa nømendim manqat sanqawe neka zøkeza matev paev-qa yaq-te, zo ùni zøtezøtéz.
Mozes āv gene-eín nqǽgo, ‘Qave neká qavo, gèzøvizáp. Gekha ezoqām ndego, eve o evo soqa manqat tembo-ein, ndego ezoqa, yà belaém.’
Geté zo ndozo-manqate, ezoqa kopømbaqapé, eve o evo sa tembo-ein, av nqægo, gekha gigiāp ndøgo, no amba qo tøtaqa-etoamɨn, ndøgo Kobán. (Taqa manqa mokho, ‘Mbumbukiam-qá.’)
Zo av ndøzøte-manqate, yaq zo ezoqa evøndipakha tøkeam-qa yaq-te, zòzømbø-khazú.
Yaq zo zøkeza nømendim matev mokho-te, atanakha-zapazapa-za-te qazo-upøgim, Mbumbukiam-qá Manqat zosanqawé. Neka zo matev av nqægo, kopoáv nandozogot.”
Ezoqam áv kené-manqa-zapa-us-ev-ɨn?
Yaq Yesu ezoqa ewaqape nqawá genømøváb, gezø-ein, “Noqa manqat ùnime꞉-yogé, zo ate nqazøte꞉go, neka mokho vømbō-ndapem!
Gigiap ndøgo, ezoqam-te ndø-oev, kopømba mbaín, te꞉-manqa-zapa-us-ev, Mbumbukiam-qa bøi-te. Geté ndǿgo tené-manqa-zapa-us-év, matev neka manqat ndøgo, te-te ndøndo-fakhate.”
Yesu nginik ezoqam gezivaz, neka khoev mokho-te vømø̄-on, yaq ekeza paev ezoqam, nqanek manqat mokho-qa yaq-te mbobevøpém.
Yaq Yesu gezø-qavøiu, “Gê, até zó-a, manqa mokho upøgimâv? Ge zô, møzøté-zøtez? Gekha gigiāp ndøgo, ezoqam-te ndø-oev, ndøgo kopømba mbaín, te꞉-manqa-zapa-us-ev, Mbumbukiam-qa bøi-te.

Zapa ndǿgo, ta gigiap ndøgo, ambá av nqǣgo, mbøni-tē qanø-oeɨ́n, geté emu-té qanø-oeɨ́n, neka nqawa vømø̄-fakhanɨn.” (Nqanek manqat mokho-te, Yesu āv gene-eín nqǽgo: Mbumbukiam-qa bøi-te, lou ate ndægo eqeieqeí. Qoté-manqa-zapa-us-eq-ák.)
Yaq Yesu gezø-ein, “Ezoqam ndǿgo tené-manqa-zapa-us-év, matev neka manqat ndøgo, te-te ndøndo-fakhate.

Zapa ndǿgo, ezoqam-qa matavap soqøsoqa, ndøgo matev soqøsoqa-te nakhoa ndøløwe, teqa mbøni-té qando-fakhaté. Ta matev soqøsoqa nqánek: Mambe matev, neka aqonam matev, neka ezoqa pakhapakha khaneam matev,

neka nøkenøkem ngi꞉wat matev, neka gigiap qovetam matev, neka sanqambap matev, neka khavozam matev, neka sapi matev, neka ova matev, neka manqa ponqom matev, neka qakeza iz eqawat matev, neka kawakawa matev.
Matev nqanek ate ndægo, ezoqam-qá mokho-té qando-fakhaté. Yaq ezoqa ndǿgo tene-manqa-zapa-us-evɨ́n.”
Bawan vini-ak sævam, Yesu gu-unimanqatin
Yesu ta manqei ndøgo ge-ivav, yaq Taya taon avønin-té genøwáv. Yaq khoev-te gemø-on, ndego poeveáv ezoqa nøme ti꞉zøtez av nqægo, ndego ngêgō. Geté ndego kopømba mbaín tekhonawat.

Ta manqei-te ndøgo, sævam mø̀ndøgoám. Tugu mbasønakam-yu, nqova soqa mbøigoám. Ngunuk sævam, Yesu-qa yaq-te até é-vøe-ewág-ae, vøndōwav, teqa zenda tokhotapak-qa megemege-te, ekeza kha, manqei vø̄elavao.
Ngunuk sævam, bawan vini-ák. Glik sævám. Finisia taon-té guqán, Silia plovins-te ndøgo. Yaq ndugu Yesu āv gumbøe-viám nqǽgo, “Nogu yu, ambá nqova soqa qombo-ngeatamín?”
Yaq Yesu gumbo-qavøiu, “Matev eqeieqeí mbá, nakheis-qa lou toqondap, yaq gaqo sasa qozǿnqagīm. Geté lou bugukhokhof nakheis betølóg, bezø̄-ewez.”
Geté yaq ndugu gundu-ein, “Evézøza. Nandav unimanqatín. Geté gaqo ndigu, lou-qase mokho-te ngu꞉sømbiap, lou khakhayakh ndølogatún, nakheis gi-ivøvemin.”
Yaq Yesu gumbo-ein, “Qoqa manqat, mokho kandambá. Khoev-té qonǿqáv. Nqova soqa ndego, qogu yu-qa mokho-te gu꞉goam, mø̀ndømbo-fakhán.”
Yaq ndugu khoev-te guqavan, tukewág ndǿgo, mbasønakam-yu, venanqei nonqo-té gumbobuvám. Neka nqova soqa mø̀ndø-fakhán, tu mokho-te gu꞉goam.
Yesu gea kandøgeap neka manqa-khou ezoqam gekhakheinøvem
Yesu nqanek manqei Taya taon avønin-te ndøgo, nqawá genø-iváv. Yaq Saedon taon-té genøwáv, vømø̄løvu, Gelili kewan-te vømø̄-ova, neka vemiav ten manqei-te sasa ndøwav.
Yesu gefakhan ndøgo, yaq gea kandøgeap neka manqa-khou ezoqam ndøndafém, te-te. Yaq zenda awam-qa mboviømém.

Yaq Yesu ndego ezoqam, ezoqa ewaqape-qa mokho-te gu꞉goam, manqei vini-té genøndáf, vømø̄-yakhapus-mokho-mba-ez. Yaq até gendego, kokosov gea nqa-te vømbōwasam, neka kokosov-te køse sasa ndøpisib, yaq nasam vømbō-khantav.
Yaq Yesu yan-té genøqán, mbøni sekeqape vø̄fok, ekeza manqat-te ge-ein, “Efatá!” Taqa manqa mokho nqánek, “Sà bemboqoé!”
Yesu nqanek manqat até é-vø-eín-ae, yaq ngenek ezoqam-qa gea gèmbo-mboqovøém, neka nasam kopømbá gembo-sasaetam, yaq ndego manqa manqate eqeieqei vø̄ngaz.
Yaq Yesu ndigu ezoqam āv genegugúb nqǽgo, “Ezoqa nøme zø̀-ei᷄n, taqa yaq-te.” Ndego manqat kopømbá gegugubam. Geté ndigu teqa emanqat, nøme mba mo꞉vøndazát.
Ndigu nqova ndafe kandambá, yaq gimanqatam, “Matev ate ndægo ndematanam, qanimav tantáv. Ezoqa gea qazø-kandøgeapam neka manqa-khou vø̄goam, ndigu ndakin kopømbá ndiyoge neka manqat ndimanqate.”

footnotes.text: Baebol kopokopo nøme-te, Glik manqat-te gipeaomem, manqat nøme ndø̂gó. Ta manqat nqánek: 16Gekha ezoqām ndego, gea tømbogoat neka yoge kopømba vømbógoāt, yà beyogé!
Yesu gaqo ge꞉-ein, zapa ndǿgo. Zu ezoqam, bawan vini-ak, gaqo me꞉zæbám.
